acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Minotaurs family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Arena Champion, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Chain-Block Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: One horn is broken and re-forged in bronze, trophies cover the heavy harness, and a chained hewn-stone block dominates the champion silhouette.

Signature mechanic: Champion's Orbit: the re-forged horn serves as a chain guide while the stone block makes one accelerating circuit; each trophy on the harness acts as a counterweight and can be destroyed to shorten the arc.
battlefieldDuty: Control a circular arena lane by orbiting a chained stone block around a bronze-repaired horn and converting family walls into moving hazards.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity horn, bronze, hewn stone, chain, coarse hide, arena dust, impact sparks, and the Bull Emperor's brazier-like eye glow remain physical or ceremonial motifs rather than Fire or Earth affinity evidence.
Motion stays mass-driven: hooves chip flooring, chains pull taut, weapons lag behind turns, and dust follows impacts without supernatural wake or material transformation.
counterplay: Step inside the circuit after the block passes, break a lifted trophy, and attack the repaired horn when the shortened chain snaps slack. Affinity signal: The loaded hoof, inside horn, weapon chain, or harness buckle remains visibly exposed during each committed line.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ordinary bronze, stone weapons, impact sparks, or brazier-like T5 eye glow as affinity construction
identityInvariants: A bull head, bovine snout and ears, wide horns, vastly overbuilt humanoid torso, digitigrade hooved legs, and thick tail remain legible at every tier.
Deep russet and black hide, bronze, ox-blood red, and bone define the family palette.
Coarse hair, horn, bronze, heavy leather harness, chain, and hewn stone remain distinct load-bearing materials.
Nose rings, horn caps, brands, arena trophies, and chained slabs communicate rank through visible history and repairs.
Weapon mass and horn spread always preserve a readable commitment direction and recovery side.
telegraph: The bronze horn catches the chain, arena trophies lift from the harness, and the block grinds a bright circular line before leaving the floor.
